history.summary: Parc Central Residences is a 99yr Executive Condominium in Tampines (D18, TOP 2025); this 1109 sqft 4BR at $1.9M / $1713 PSF. EC PSF at $1713 is rich, and as a brand-new EC it is locked under the 5-year Minimum Occupation Period — it cannot be resold on the open market for ~5 years, which is fatal to a 5-7yr investment hold.
history.rating_rationale: As a 2025-TOP EC, the MOP runs ~5 years from key collection, so an investor buying now cannot sell within most of a 5-7yr horizon and EC subletting of the whole unit is restricted during MOP — gutting both exit and rental income, the two pillars of the investment case. $1713 PSF is also high for a D18 EC. No MRT distance listed and no URA data. The compact 1109 sqft 4BR squeezes four bedrooms into a small plate, signalling efficiency over livability.
red_flags: EC under MOP — cannot resell on open market for ~5yrs; whole-unit subletting restricted during MOP
$1713 PSF is high for a D18 EC
1109 sqft 4BR is very compact — tight, niche layout
No MRT proximity listed; no URA data
catalysts: Tampines Regional Centre + Cross Island Line catchment
Post-MOP privatisation eventually opens the buyer pool to PRs

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Effectively zero rental viability during the MOP for an investor (only rooms, not the whole unit, can be sublet); post-MOP a compact 4BR EC in Tampines lets to families at modest yield.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: ECs do appreciate at privatisation, but the MOP lockup means this does not fit a 5-7yr investment exit, and $1713 PSF leaves little headroom. No URA data to support an override.
